female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

family-responsibilities-slower-general.title: Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
family-responsibilities-slower-general.body: Pitches that reference household duties or the need to support family members are associated with slower funding speeds for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

female-local-currency-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the loan amount in local currency fund faster.
female-local-currency-faster.body: Pitches from women that mention the loan amount in the local currency of their country are associated with increased funding speed.

female-family-living-conditions-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention improving family living conditions may fund faster.

female-hardworking-template-faster.body: Female borrowers using a standardized template describing a 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund faster.

female-geographic-specificity-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific towns or local geographic markers may fund more slowly.

female-environmental-impact-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention positive environmental impact in their pitches may fund faster.

female-marital-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state their marital status as married or widowed may fund faster.

female-children-count-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the number of children in their pitch may fund faster.

female-professional-skills-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe specific professional skills or years of experience may fund faster.

female-inventory-specificity-slower.body: Female borrowers who list specific types of equipment or inventory may fund more slowly.

female-nwtf-history-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention past loans from specific institutions like NWTF may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-faster-revised.body: Female borrowers who explicitly thank lenders in their pitch may fund faster.

female-personal-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize their personal status in the pitch may fund faster.
female-personal-status-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for environmental impact puzzle

female-single-widowed-slower.title: Female borrowers who specify their marital status as single or widowed may fund more slowly.
female-single-widowed-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that stating marital status (including widow) is associated with faster funding

female-spouse-stability-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a spouse's employment as a source of stability may fund faster.
female-spouse-stability-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations

male-business-cycle-specificity-faster.title: Male borrowers who describe a specific business operational cycle may fund faster.
male-business-cycle-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for resurfacing children-count observation

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who use gratitude markers may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that elaborate gratitude markers are associated with faster funding

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who use elaborate gratitude markers may fund faster.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that explicit gratitude markers are associated with slower funding

female-product-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list multiple specific types of products sold may fund faster.
female-product-specificity-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific equipment/inventory lists are associated with slower funding

female-securing-family-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-securing-family-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted age claim

female-age-slower-claim.title: Pitches from women that mention the borrower's specific age are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-ag-technical-faster.title: Female borrowers in agriculture who describe specific technical benefits of farm inputs may fund faster.
